plan.title: bug(scm,release): release Step 3 fails with an empty-stderr exit 1 once the open-issue inventory exceeds 1 MB (ENOBUFS in scm call)

narratives.Description: bug(scm,release): release Step 3 fails with an empty-stderr exit 1 once the open-issue inventory exceeds 1 MB (ENOBUFS in scm call)
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

`task release` cannot cut a release on this repo. Step 3 (pre-flight xBRIEF lifecycle sync) fetches the complete open-issue inventory through `scm/call.ts::call`, whose `spawnSync` omits `maxBuffer`. Node defaults to 1 MB. This repo's inventory is ~4.1 MB, so the capture aborts with `ENOBUFS`: `status === null`, truncated stdout, empty stderr.

`call()` reports `returncode: result.status ?? 1` and never surfaces `result.error.message`, so the operator sees an exit 1 with no reason and a hint that points at the wrong thing:

```
open-issue inventory fetch failed: gh api failed: endpoint='repos/deftai/directive/issues?state=open&per_page=100' exit=1 stderr=''; hint: verify gh auth and core REST quota; open-issue inventory must be complete
[3/13] Pre-flight vBRIEF lifecycle sync... FAIL (failed to fetch issue states from gh)
```

Auth was healthy and `core.remaining` was 4985 at the time of failure. The same `ghx api --paginate --slurp` call succeeds from a shell and under a plain `spawnSync` that passes the ceiling.

## Reproduction

```
node -e "
const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');
const r=spawnSync('ghx',['api','--paginate','--slurp','repos/deftai/directive/issues?state=open&per_page=100'],{encoding:'utf8',timeout:120000,env:process.env,stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe']});
console.log(r.status, r.error && r.error.code, (r.stderr||'').length, (r.stdout||'').length);
"
```

Observed: `null ENOBUFS 0 1112000`. With `maxBuffer: 64*1024*1024` added: `0 undefined 0 4158002`.

## Root cause

- `packages/core/src/scm/call.ts` -- `spawnSync` passes no `maxBuffer`.
- `packages/core/src/subprocess/max-buffer.ts` already documents the rule this violates: every capture site that may produce a large response MUST pass `SUBPROCESS_MAX_BUFFER`, and MUST surface `result.error.message` when stderr is empty so an overflow is never silent again (#1867). `runGhApi` in `scm/gh-rest.ts` does both. `call()` does neither.
- `packages/core/src/release/issue-state-fetch.ts::scmCallToRunGhApi` routes the #3752 paginated inventory through `call()`, so the one-subprocess-complete-inventory design inherits a 1 MB ceiling.

The trigger is repository size, not configuration: the failure arrives silently the first time a repo's open-issue list crosses 1 MB, and is permanent from then on.

## Impact

Blocks every `task release` cut on deftai/directive at Step 3, before any mutation. The only current escape is `--allow-vbrief-drift`, which skips the lifecycle gate the step exists to enforce -- trading a release blocker for an unchecked lifecycle invariant.

## Acceptance criteria

1. `call()` passes `SUBPROCESS_MAX_BUFFER` to `spawnSync`.
2. `call()` surfaces `result.error.message` when `status === null` and stderr is empty, so ENOBUFS and timeout kills never report as a bare exit 1 with no reason.
3. Regression test: a `call()` capture whose stdout exceeds 1 MB succeeds, and a forced spawn-level failure reports a non-empty reason.
4. `task release -- <version> --dry-run` Step 3 completes against this repo (open-issue inventory over 1 MB).
5. Remaining `spawnSync` / `execFileSync` capture sites that can return large payloads are audited; each either passes the ceiling or records why it cannot.

Refs #1867, #3752, #3767.
narratives.Audit:
Capture-site audit for acceptance criterion 5 (all spawnSync / execFileSync sites under packages/, 2026-08-28).

Ceiling added in this change (payload is unbounded or already past 1 MB):
- scm/call.ts -- the reported defect; carries the paginated open-issue inventory (4.1 MB on this repo).
- check/cached-orchestrator.ts captureSpawn -- captures the whole stdout of a task verb, including check lanes and test runs.
- architecture/sor-preflight.ts gitDiff -- full unified patch against the base ref.
- codebase/provider.ts runProviderCommand -- stdout of an operator-configured projection command.
- session/git.ts defaultGitRunner -- git show streams whole blobs; SPECIFICATION.md alone is 1.8 MB.

The empty-reason fallback is shared as resolveCaptureFailureStderr (subprocess/max-buffer.ts): a capture that failed at the spawn level with no status and no stderr reports the error message, while a process that exited with a status keeps the silence it chose.

Already at a ceiling, no change: scm/gh-rest.ts runGhApi, release/spawn.ts, release/build-dist.ts, review-monitor/github-lease.ts, umbrella-current-shape/index.ts, swarm/subprocess.ts, forward-coverage/evaluate.ts, verify-env/command-spawn.ts, verify-env/agent-hooks-live-probe.ts, pr-merge-readiness/gh.ts, pr-protected-issues/gh.ts, pr-closing-keywords/gh.ts, pr-wait-mergeable/wrappers.ts, cli/init-cli/run-deft-install.ts, session/git.ts showBlobsBatch (own 64 MB cat-file constant), literal-acceptance/run.ts (own 16 MB shell ceiling).

No ceiling required, reason recorded:
- Inherited stdio, nothing is captured: check/orchestrator.ts defaultSpawn, ts-check-lane/run-lane.ts defaultRunner.
- Path lists and name-only diffs: encoding/git.ts, coverage-hotspots/evaluate.ts, scope-provenance/evaluate.ts, lifecycle/completed-write-guard.ts, verify-source/content-manifest.ts, init-deposit/hygiene.ts, orchestration/verify-judgment-gates.ts, eval-triggers-relocation, eval-health-relocation, migrate-preflight/index.ts. git ls-files is 269 KB at 4332 tracked files, the largest of this class.
- Single values or short probes: branch/git.ts, capacity/backfill.ts, session/session-ready.ts, session/active-cli.ts, session/release-availability.ts, doctor/which.ts, doctor/npm-view.ts, doctor/npm-registry.ts, doctor/payload-staleness.ts, check-updates/index.ts, intake/github-auth-modes.ts, intake/reconcile-issues.ts, triage/author-filter.ts, product-signal/sink-bootstrap.ts, verify-env/verify-tools.ts, verify-env/verify-hooks-installed.ts, verify-env/toolchain-check.ts, init-deposit (gitignore, scaffold, untrack-core, legacy-detect, refresh, hook-runtime-travel), release/native-steps.ts, release/cli-drift-report.ts, triage/smoketest/index.ts.
- Test-only or fixture spawns: cli/render-cli/deft-ts-runner.ts, cli/gates-cli/_helpers.ts, cli/branch-fixtures.ts, cli/story-ready-fixtures.ts, cli/slice.ts, cli/scope-lifecycle.ts, cli/triage-scope.ts (thin shims that replay one verb's output).
